title: Tree Cadastre – monthly exchange file to the regional environmental agency
description: Envelope for the monthly delivery (S1 UC5). HAND-WRITTEN wrapper (decision D-010): it only arranges the generated object definitions from schema.json (same version) into flat lists; every object definition is generated from model.yaml. Content: all objects created or changed in the reporting period (delta, A-004), plus the species, sites and contractors they reference. Staff members (personal data) are never included; inspections/measures carry only the pseudonymous staff id. Geometries are GeoJSON-structured but with coordinates in EPSG:25832 (D-011, Q-006).

schemaVersion.description: Version of the tree cadastre model the file conforms to.

sender.description: Delivering organisation, e.g. the city's parks department.

crs.description: Coordinate reference system of all coordinates in this file.

$comment: Referential integrity (every referenced id is present in the file or was delivered earlier) and the rules C-001..C-011 cannot be expressed in JSON Schema; they are checked by the producer before sending.
